precision: Reuse _configure_ease_precision: FP32 parameters, no autocast, CUDA matmul TF32 off, cuDNN TF32 on, deterministic=True, benchmark=False.
algorithm_hyperparameters: Retain existing manifest learning rates and method-specific settings; L2P/DualPrompt batchwise_prompt=0. Record effective args including each method's native learning-rate scaling.

accuracy_policy.scope: Accuracy must be strictly greater than 20% as an abnormal-collapse guard for a ten-class, one-epoch pilot; predictions must match reported accuracy. This is not paper reproduction and does not apply EASE's twenty-epoch 1.5/3.0pp margins.

measurement_policy: Each method runs measurement, measurement, measurement+separate FLOPs in order. Only the three measurement passes enter median/min/max efficiency statistics. EASE is reused without a new experiment.
